topography.project_purpose: Zoth is a DeFi protocol that bridges real-world assets (RWAs) with decentralized finance by offering tokenized yield-bearing products and a collateralized debt position (CDP) system. Users can deposit stablecoins or tokenized real-world assets into vaults to earn yield, mint the ZeUSD stablecoin against collateral, and manage positions across multiple chains.
topography.relationship_narrative: The ZeUSD CDP & Vaults family relies on shared registries, access managers, and oracles to coordinate collateral deposits and stablecoin minting across multiple sub-vault types. The zOPAL family uses its own access control and oracles but follows a similar vault-based pattern, while the ZTLN-P token serves as collateral within the ZeUSD ecosystem, creating a unified RWA-backed DeFi platform.
